sceneReset: Import empty JSON through the actual Load form before each scene. If empty import is unavailable, use the UI Clear command and record its actual confirmation flow; freeze that flow for both phases.
interactionPolicy: Use actual JSON fill+Apply, Layout/Offset, sample UI, native Fit/Reset/Zoom, and only read-only DOM inspection. No Cytoscape or localStorage mutation through evaluate. Obtain DOM state after each action batch. Screenshots precede label bounds inspection.
screenshotSequence: Main49 first, then two boundary scenes with five child photos each. Keep immediate imports free of any viewport operation after final Apply. Native-auto-fit scenes use Fit only before actions, then no explicit viewport changes after actions; actual zoom is recorded.
samplePolicy: All five Platonic previews and applied scenes use actual sample UI with default parameters, undirected/unweighted and offset on. After replays sample application rather than importing Before coordinates.
